messages:
Maya Singh: Quick follow-up on the model-serving timeouts postmortem. I sketched actions + owners; please confirm by EOD so Ops can create tickets.
Omar Reyes: Paste the list here? I'll claim anything infra-related.
Maya Singh: Short list: 
- T1: Investigate root cause of collector stall under burst traffic (owner: Omar, due: 2026-04-01, ticket: none yet)
- T2: Add short-window circuit breaker at API gateway (owner: Hannah, due: 2026-04-08, JIRA: RED-3005)
- T3: Update runbook with explicit rollback steps and add acceptance checklist (owner: Maya, due: 2026-03-29, no-jira)
- T4: Create cross-incident epic to track recurring timeout patterns and mitigation roadmap (owner: Devon, due: 2026-04-20, JIRA: RED-3006)
Hannah Brooks: I'll take T2. Planning feature-flag + 30% canary for 72h. Will add metrics P99 latency + error-rate to the ticket.
Devon Kim: For T4 I'll link 2025-09 and 2025-11 PMs and propose an epic RED-3006 with capacity for long-term fixes.
PMBot: Created JIRA RED-3005 (link: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/RED-3005)
PMBot: Created JIRA RED-3006 (link: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/RED-3006)
Omar Reyes: For T1 I'll need the collector flamegraphs from the incident run. @Maya where did you store them?
Maya Singh: s3://pm-artifacts/2026-03-timeouts/collectors. Shared perms with Omar and Hannah.
Hannah Brooks: RACI note: T2 responsible=Hannah, accountable=Infra Lead, consulted=ML Eng, informed=Customer Success. Add temp_owner field when owners go on PTO.
Devon Kim: Suggest weekly 10m owner sync until all tickets leave "Open". Tue 10:00 works?
Maya Singh: Works for me. I'll send invite and maintain a one-line status update in the PM doc after each sync.
Omar Reyes: One more ask: add a "recurrence" label and a checkbox in the ticket template for "long-term mitigation required" so we can surface patterns.
InfraBot: Template updated: added recurrence label + long_term_mitigation checkbox + temp_owner field.
Maya Singh: Thanks everyone. Please update ticket ownership and comment "accept" in the ticket by EOD. I'll close this thread after the first sync. :thumbsup:
